title: source-gates never runs scripts/test-repository-check-scope.mjs, which bun run test runs first
description: Found closing QCLI-375 (2026-09-25). package.json test runs test:repository-check-scope, then test:package-artifact-delivery, then bun test. After QCLI-375, source-gates (prepublish.mjs runSourceGates) runs the second (package_artifact_delivery gate) and every test/ file, but NOT scripts/test-repository-check-scope.mjs, so a PR that breaks it goes green in CI. OBJECT MEASURED: runSourceGates at fix/QCLI-375 head 07f8358, and package.json scripts. NOT MEASURED: any other scripts/test-*.mjs outside bun run test. Likely a one-line named gate, proved the QCLI-375 way (a deliberate break goes red naming the gate, and its revert goes green).

acceptanceCriteria.text: source-gates runs scripts/test-repository-check-scope.mjs as its own named gate
A deliberate break in that script turns source-gates red naming the gate, and its revert turns it green (two CI measurements)
